full_judgment: 13; Thus on examination we find that both the Deputy Commissioner and the Department have their own points to make and in the interest of all concerned the views of both need be accommodated. We have noted with appreciation that the Deputy Commissioner has indicated in his communication shown to us that "if the vendor comes up with proposal for khas land that may be made available to him on the basis of lease as per government rules."
